# Introduction

This tutorial demonstrates the complete FYF (Fix Your FITS) workflow using the command-line interface. We’ll:

-   Mask a FITS file with simulated cosmic rays and satellite trails
-   Fill the masked regions using R-INLA spatial reconstruction
-   Compare the original with the reconstructed image
-   Analyze masked pixel performance using Python metrics

FYF is based on the work of [Spatial field Reconstruction with INLA](https://academic.oup.com/mnras/article/482/3/3880/5144230) and implements Bayesian spatial statistics for astronomical image reconstruction.


# Prerequisites

Before starting, ensure you have FYF installed

```
# Check FYF installation and dependencies
python -m fyf version
```
